message.content:
**Yes – you can file a noise complaint with the City of Atlanta’s local authorities.**  
In the United States, “local council” usually refers to the city council, but noise complaints are typically handled by the city’s **Police Department** or **Code Enforcement** office rather than the council itself. Here’s how you can do it:

| Step | What to Do | Where to Go / Who to Contact |
|------|------------|------------------------------|
| 1 | **Check the Noise Ordinance** | The City of Atlanta’s official website has the *Noise Ordinance* (Title 10, Chapter 2). It lists prohibited times, decibel limits, and what constitutes a violation. |
| 2 | **File an Online Complaint** | Use the City of Atlanta’s **311 Service Portal** (https://www.atlantaga.gov/311) or the **Atlanta Police Department’s online reporting tool** (https://www.atlantaga.gov/311). Select “Noise” or “Code Enforcement” as the issue. |
| 3 | **Call 311** | If you prefer phone, dial **311** from within Atlanta or **(404) 656-3111**. This will connect you to the city’s non-emergency line. |
| 4 | **Visit the Police Station** | For urgent or ongoing disturbances, you can also go to the nearest police precinct. The main precinct is the **Central Precinct** at 1000 Peachtree Street NE. |
| 5 | **Contact the Code Enforcement Office** | If the issue involves building violations or construction noise, you can reach out to the **Code Enforcement Division** at (404) 656-3111 or via email at **codeenforcement@atlantaga.gov**. |
| 6 | **Follow Up** | After filing, you’ll receive a reference number. Keep it handy for follow‑up calls or emails. |

### Quick Reference

| Resource | Link | Phone |
|----------|------|-------|
| City of Atlanta Official Site | https://www.atlantaga.gov | |
| 311 Service Portal | https://www.atlantaga.gov/311 | (404) 656-3111 |
| Atlanta Police Department | https://www.atlantaga.gov/police | (404) 656-3111 |
| Code Enforcement | https://www.atlantaga.gov/code-enforcement | (404) 656-3111 |
| Noise Ordinance PDF | https://www.atlantaga.gov/sites/default/files/Noise%20Ordinance.pdf | |

### Tips

- **Document the Incident**: Note the date, time, location, and description of the noise. If possible, record a short audio clip (but be mindful of privacy laws).
- **Be Specific**: Mention whether it’s a residential, commercial, or construction noise issue.
- **Know the Hours**: The ordinance typically prohibits loud noises between 10 p.m. and 7 a.m. on weekdays and 11 p.m. to 8 a.m. on weekends.

If you’re outside Atlanta or need more detailed guidance, feel free to ask!
